interpretation: Adding the fixed support planes resolved the mathematical condition-number obstacle, but did not independently validate the new method on the actual saved fields.

The failure is not merely a0.0078-percentage-point absolute-closure threshold overrun: the independently held-out electric-field errors and1.26-1.32percent incident-power errors also fail their retained checks.

Failure on the previously passing AC2 control suggests sensitivity of this new near-boundary support/group-holdout reconstruction. It does not by itself identify a unique physical or numerical root cause, nor justify changing source power, materials, thresholds, or geometry.
Both fixed cutoffs remain mutually stable and the old primary-five estimates reproduce. These facts preserve exploratory usefulness but do not erase the new held-out-field limitation.

findings_zh: H120、10.5 μm法向s/p平均材料损耗在1/2/3 μm底填充为36.5470%/31.3704%/37.0545%，非单调；13 μm法向p由1 μm的24.7726%增至3 μm的42.7417%。膜厚效应随波长和几何变化，不能直接沿用平面最优膜厚。
H80、3 μm底填充、10.5 μm同一精确网格的20个独立偏振点组成9对s/p；A_port均值θ15约23.98–24.99%、θ30约15.51–15.76%、θ60约9.61–10.07%。θ22.5φ0的s/p为18.2941%/20.6822%，差2.3880 pp；这是稀疏方向趋势，尚无全角域积分。
10.5 μm θ22.5φ0、3 μm底填充，H60/H100的s/p材料损耗均值17.9920%/21.5393%，四点保存场方法通过。高度改变也改变壁面倾角和填充上表面面积，并非纯光程变化。
H80、3 μm底填充、法向p实际已有9/10.5/11.5/13 μm四个离散物理解，A_loss依次41.6129%/34.1266%/37.4341%/43.2792%。早期9 μm网格未经过后续短波精细损耗分辨验证；原始净流警告均保留，不能将四点连线视作收敛宽谱或带平均。V1是10.5 μm局部顶网格重复34.1252%，另计记录不加新物理条件。
9μm法向H100/t3的p/s材料损耗38.8520%/38.8698%，均保留净通量及保存场方法失败；与H60/t3 p的29.4402%构成探索性谱点，但不宜据此形成严格尺寸规律。

machine_learning.target: Local surrogate of A_loss(H,t | lambda,theta,phi,pol) at fixed A3 lateral geometry, for coverage and next-sample selection; later multiobjective optimization only after band/cone labels and fabrication constraints exist.
machine_learning.validation: Leave one complete H/t design out globally before selecting each condition. No row-random split; training-only scaling; fixed model settings.
machine_learning.prospective_scope_warning: H100/t2 four conditions are one genuinely unseen complete design, not four independent unseen structures; H80/t2 oblique tests are unseen conditions of a partly known design.
conclusions_zh: 机器学习已经实现并在本地运行，无需另装图形化机器学习软件；Python库和复现代码构成训练环境。
8个独立H/t设计不足以支持全局结构寻优。法向整结构留出GP MAE约4.20个百分点，不优于均值约4.12；ridge约3.68。
对冻结模型的H100/t2前瞻验证，四条件GP MAE约1.12个百分点，优于均值约2.54/ridge约1.64，但只有一个新设计，证据仍局部。
当前应优先补H×t交叉覆盖并保持整结构留出验证；不要将更多偏振/角度行当作更多独立尺寸。

synthesis.scope: Literature grounded process feasibility and explanation; no new electromagnetic runs
key_findings: A3 dimension scale is laser machinable in principle; exact sharp-cornered smooth-wall narrow-bottom dense-array morphology not demonstrated by user equipment
SiO2 is a traceable MIR dielectric benchmark, not a demonstrated unique optimum or mandatory material
510nm sputtered SiO2 n,k do not validate porous sol-gel or particle deposit n,k
2um H100 ideal bottom-fill dry volume 0.418741pL; deposition morphology must be measured
Oblique absorptance is a reciprocal-channel computational route to directional thermal emissivity; outgoing and incoming k have opposite signs
synthesis.recommended_next_step: Calibrate manufacturable bare TA2 cavities; compare realistic sol-gel coating or localized filling morphology with bare control; update geometry and material optical inputs before wider ML/angle optimization

limits_zh: 钛上约100μm激光微加工和六边形图案各有实验文献支持，尚不能证明当前P80/开口69.55/底15/H80–100的精确光滑盲腔已可由现有设备复制。
2–3μm理想底填充与共形涂层是两种材料几何；浸涂/ALD会覆盖壁与台面，不能套用底填充结果。
公共510nm溅射SiO2光学常数不代表多孔溶胶凝胶/颗粒膜；应实测同工艺见证片与腔内形貌。

next_plan_zh.action: 先交付全阶段证据一致的报告、曲线、几何和互易角示意；明确历史3D角点与本批补样的关系。
next_plan_zh.purpose: 让老师区分完成内容、可支持结论和缺口。

next_plan_zh.action: 补未覆盖的H/t交叉点（已提出的H60/t2与H80/t1等需单独资源排程与授权），固定10.5μm和可比方向/偏振。
next_plan_zh.purpose: 降低高度与厚度混淆，检验代理在新结构上的预测；这些不是已完成结果。

next_plan_zh.action: 以代表点做有限网格/角半径/膜形貌敏感性，完成必要的旧保存场核算诊断；不因同一残差无意义反复重跑。
next_plan_zh.purpose: 将可信趋势与数值/形貌不确定性分开。

next_plan_zh.action: 选少量候选，补共同波长8–13μm及θ/φ采样，再做网格积分收敛，计算带平均、目标锥功率Q、锥占比C、峰方向与半峰宽。
next_plan_zh.purpose: 从单点和稀疏角响应走向目标带内方向性。

next_plan_zh.action: 并行校准TA2激光腔及SiO2制备路线，测量H/口径/底宽/圆角/粗糙氧化、膜厚和n,k，回填真实形貌与光学输入。
next_plan_zh.purpose: 把数值代理转化为可加工的实验方案，而非只优化理想模型。
